item.title: Bridge repairs on I-75 to cause detours, partially shut down highway in Marion County
item.description: Motorists traveling through northern Marion County will face detours starting Thursday as state officials close a bridge over Interstate 75 for repairs, a project that will also require overnight shutdowns of the interstate itself next week. item.title: Crews pouring foundation for new fire station in north Ocala
item.description: Construction is moving swiftly at the site of the future Marion County Fire Rescue Lowell Fire Station #11, where crews have raised the walls and are preparing for the next phase of foundation work. Read more: Crews pouring foundation for new fire station in north Ocala

item.title: Sam’s Club blames Ocala shopper for slipping on broken eggs, denies liability
item.description: Sam’s Club has formally responded to a lawsuit filed by a woman who claims she suffered permanent injuries after slipping on broken eggs at an Ocala location, denying any negligence and arguing the shopper was at fault for not paying attention. Read more: Sam’s Club blames Ocala shopper for slipping on broken eggs, denies liability
